checks.statement: row 3 sees exactly the interior column (g+6,+)
checks.detail: parity gives a=g+6; all minus supports end below row 3

checks.statement: the final minus column cannot couple to row 2 or the plus endpoint
checks.detail: I(g+8,-)=[-2g-8,-g-7], disjoint from row 2 and endpoint support [0,g+1]

checks.statement: the local core pivot is -3*(g+6 rising g)
the transverse response is the one-pivot Schur complement E-CB/A
the symbolic formula proves the observed grade-two recurrence
tau_g is nonzero at every even integral grade g>=2
checks.detail: all other factors are positive; Q has nonsquare discriminant 105

verdict: Support triangularity reduces the row-3 transverse Schur complement to one interior pivot: tau=E-CB/A for the column (g+6,+). Four symbolic path coefficients give tau_g=-8(2g+3)(g^2-g-26)(2g+1)!/[3(g+5)(g+6)(g+7)(g-1)!]. This proves the observed recurrence and all-even-grade nonvanishing; no growing determinant or fitted recurrence remains.
